title: 建築設備学
subtitle: Building Equipment
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn about human thermal sensation and comfortable ranges of temperature and humidity.
(2) learn how to calculate the heating and cooling loads of buildings.
(3) learn about various kind of air conditioning systems.
(4) learn about heat source equipment such as boilers, refrigerators, and heat pumps.
advice:
In this course, after recognizing the quantitative size of the transmission heat loads of buildings through exercises, students learn about the calculation methods for various heat loads, such as direct gains from solar radiation, ventilation, lighting, human bodies, and indoor heat generated by machine and instruments.
Next, students learn about air conditioning equipment and the kinds of systems that correspond to different heating and cooling loads.
Students will also come to understand the features of the various compositions of heat source equipment used to control energy consumption and carbon dioxide emissions.
1. Passive design of architecture
2. Ａir conditioning design /heat load calculation
3. Using of moist air diagram
4. Air conditioning system
5. Air conditioning equipment
6. Heat source system
7.Environmental facility planning from the viewpoint of regional.
8. Green architecture in harmony with the environment
9. Water supply, drainage and sanitation facilities
books:
Environmental Design and Systems for Architecture
ICHIGAYA Publishing Co.,Ltd.
requiredKnowledge: Students should have taken Introduction to Building Equipment, Architectural Environment I.

activityGoals.body: Students can calculate the heating and cooling loads of buildings.
Students can explain the meaning of terms related to air conditioning equipment, etc.
Students can explain the differences in the kinds of air conditioning and heat source systems.
Students can solve the problems that appear on the Japanese registered architect examination.
Students can give an overview of the Building Energy Efficiency Act.
Students can explain the feature of eco-buildings.

achievementLevels.ideal:
Students can:
(1) calculate heating and cooling load of buildings at any time by classifying loads into latent and sensible heat.
(2) explain the meaning of terms related to air conditioning equipment, and know the variable names used in heating and cooling load calculations, heat source equipment, and human thermal sensation and its indexes.
(3) explain the differences between kinds of air conditioning and heat source systems, including their normal operation and during disasters.
(4) solve problems from the Japanese registered architect first-class license examination.
achievementLevels.standard:
Students can:
(1) calculate heating and cooling loads of buildings.
(2) explain the meaning of terms related to air conditioning equipment, etc.
(3) explain the differences between kinds of air conditioning and heat source systems.
(4) solve problems from the Japanese registered architect second-class license examination.
